summarize_laikago_constants: summarize the laikago_constants module which defines URDF specs and joint configuration for the Laikago quadruped robot
review_JOINT_NAMES: review the JOINT_NAMES tuple that lists all 12 joint names across 4 legs of the Laikago robot
review_INIT_JOINT_ANGLES: review the INIT_JOINT_ANGLES OrderedDict mapping each joint to its initial abduction, hip, and knee angles
review_JOINT_OFFSETS: review the JOINT_OFFSETS OrderedDict used to convert SDK joint angles to URDF joint angles
review_gin_constants: review the gin.constant registrations that expose laikago robot constants for gin config binding
